name: SHUFFLE!
source:
The discovery of gates to the realms of gods and demons a decade ago brought magic and supernatural beings into the human world, leading to a new era of coexistence.

In Kouyou Town, Tsuchimi Rin, an orphaned human student living with his childhood friend, attends Verbena Academy alongside students from all three races. His ordinary life takes a sharp turn when the God King and Devil King move to town with their daughters, who harbor long-held affections for Rin from a past encounter.

In a shocking turn of events, both kings declare Rin as a potential suitor for their daughters, promising him the throne if he chooses one of them. Faced with this unexpected predicament and the prospect of becoming either a god or a devil, Rin's life is thrown into a whirlwind where secrets unravel, destinies collide, and fates intertwine.

[From [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/SHUFFLE!]Wikipedia[/url] and [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=670736]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
十年前，通往神界与魔界的门户被发现，魔法和超自然种族由此进入人类世界，三族共存的新时代也随之到来。

在人类世界的光阳町，孤儿土见凛与青梅竹马一同生活，并在国立巴贝纳学园与来自人、神、魔三族的学生共同就读。神王和魔王带着各自的女儿迁居此地后，凛平凡的生活骤然改变。两位公主都因昔日的一场邂逅，长久以来对他怀有爱意。

更令人震惊的是，两位王竟同时宣布凛可以迎娶自己的女儿，并承诺只要他作出选择，便可继承相应的王位。面对这场突如其来的婚姻难题，以及成为神或魔的可能，凛的生活被卷入漩涡；秘密逐一揭开，命运彼此碰撞，众人的缘分也交织在一起。

[译自[url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/SHUFFLE!]维基百科[/url]及[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=670736]Getchu[/url]]
